description.value:
Reaching out through the dark side, you attempt to siphon life from a living target. Make a melee force attack against the creature. On a hit, it takes 1d6 necrotic damage, and you gain temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt, lasting until the end of your next turn.

The damage rises to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th level, and 4d6 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, At-Will
